# #4844: Patch: Fortify and Hopeful Jelly Bean are declared as helping their target, so a stolen or random cast lands them on its caster's side, not the enemy's
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

Training Grounds #12 Fortify ("Give a Unit +5 Health, +1 Armor and Taunt"; Radiant adds Divine Shield) and #27 Hopeful Jelly Bean ("Make a permanent Radiant") declare their target with a bare `TargetDecl::target(1, 1, … "side": "any" …)` and no `aim`:

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/training_grounds/c012_fortify.rs:13`
- `crates/cards/src/scripts/training_grounds/c027_hopeful_jelly_bean.rs:17`

`targeting::target_aim` (`crates/engine/src/targeting.rs`) reads a missing aim as `Harm`. So every cast that picks targets for its caster by the declaration's aim sends these two buffs to the **caster's enemy**.

Concrete: P2 controls Classic #4 Palantir. P1 plays Fortify on P1's own Unit. Palantir steals it and casts it for P2 with `targetEnemies`. The pick narrows to the caster's enemies, so P1's Unit gets the +5 Health, Armor and Taunt and P2's Unit gets nothing: P2's own trap handed P1 the buff. Hopeful Jelly Bean behaves the same way: the thief's cast makes the victim's Unit Radiant.

Other routes to the same result:

- C+ #38.1 Solarius Prime casts random Spells of every shipped set (Training Grounds ships), each with `target_enemies: Some(true)`. Its printed text: "Each aims at enemies when it harms and at your side when it helps."
- C+ #40 Appropriations' `targetEnemies` enchantment.
- R1200 and R1201's Lucky reroll (`random_targets.rs`), which prefers "the aim's side", so a Lucky caster's random Fortify is steered toward enemies.

### What should happen

- R656: "Every target declaration says whether it harms ("harm") or helps ("help"), harmful by default … a harmful pick narrows to enemies when one is legal, a helpful one to friends when one is legal".
- R831001 (Palantir): "each target pick aimed by its declaration (R656: a harmful pick narrows to the caster's enemies, a helpful one to their friends, when one is offered), so "in your favor" never asks the caster anything".

Both cards help their target, so the thief's own Unit should take them.

### How to reproduce

Two tests fail on `main` (3a83bd7), and a control passes, in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_tg_mplus.rs` at f9ffcdf](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/f9ffcdf/crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_tg_mplus.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`; the file sits in the AI crate's tests only because that target links the testkit and every card).

```rust
use jackioh_engine::testkit::PlayerId::{P1, P2};
use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;
const FILLER: &str = "core-005";
const PALANTIR: &str = "classic-004";
const MINE: &str = "stand-in (1) 3/3";
const THEIRS: &str = "stand-in (1) 4/4";

fn stolen_by_palantir(spell: Value) -> (Scenario, String, String) {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    let mut s = scenario(json!({
        "seed": "audit-aim",
        "p1": { "hand": [spell], "field": [{ "def": MINE, "lane": 1 }], "library": [FILLER, FILLER, FILLER], "mana": 10 },
        "p2": { "hand": [FILLER], "field": [{ "def": THEIRS, "lane": 1 }],
                "backrow": [{ "def": PALANTIR, "faceUp": true }], "library": [FILLER, FILLER, FILLER] },
    }));
    let mine = s.unit_at(P1, 1).id;
    let theirs = s.unit_at(P2, 1).id;
    let card = s.hand(P1)[0].id.clone();
    s.play(card.as_str(), pick::targets(pick::id(&mine)));
    (s, mine, theirs)
}

#[test]
fn r656_fortify_cast_by_a_cast_that_targets_enemies_lands_on_its_casters_unit() {
    const FORTIFY: &str = "traininggrounds-012";
    // costMod +1: Palantir takes Spells of a cost it can steal; the seed's price is (2).
    let (s, mine, theirs) = stolen_by_palantir(json!({ "def": FORTIFY, "costMod": 1 }));
    assert!(s.pile(P2, "graveyard").iter().any(|card| card.def_id == FORTIFY), "P2 stole and cast it");
    let mine = unit_view(s.state(), s.card(mine.as_str()));
    let theirs = unit_view(s.state(), s.card(theirs.as_str()));
    assert_eq!(theirs.max_health, 9, "the caster's own Unit takes the +5 Health");
    assert_eq!(mine.max_health, 3, "the caster's enemy takes no buff");
}
```

The Hopeful Jelly Bean test has the same shape (`traininggrounds-027` with `costMod: -2`), asserting P2's Unit is Radiant and P1's is not.

Output today: `the caster's own Unit takes the +5 Health   left: 4   right: 9` (P1's Unit is 3/8), and `the caster's own Unit becomes Radiant`. The control passes: TG #59 Fig of Life declares `"aim": "help"`, and the same stolen cast heals P2's side.

### Where

Cards: `crates/cards/src/scripts/training_grounds/c012_fortify.rs`, `c027_hopeful_jelly_bean.rs`, and whatever the sweep below finds.

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- Declare `aim: Some(TargetAim::Help)` on both cards' target declarations, as `c002_personal_trainer.rs:15` and `c059_fig_of_life.rs:39` in the same set do. Each card's R656 test goes in its own file (CLAUDE.md rule 6).
- **Sweep the rest, bounded.** 104 script files declare a `"side": "any"` target with no helpful aim. Most are rightly harmful (damage, destroy, bounce) or could go either way. Read each one's printed text once and declare `help` only where the effect can only help its target. Named by the audit as likely, not yet read: `stinkyscape/c010_2_divine_spirit.rs`, `c010_3_power_word_shield.rs`, `stinkyscape_plus/c047_plastanium.rs`, `c048_thorium.rs`, `c049_metaglass.rs`. Leave alone the ones whose help depends on the target (TG #34 Dino-size sets a Unit to 10/10; S #10.1 Inner Fire sets Attack to Health): say in the pull request which were left and why. `docs/issues-and-patches.md`, "A task over every card", says how such a pass is done.
- **Replays.** The change moves where a replayed targets-enemies cast lands, so each changed script keeps its old version in `KEPT_SCRIPTS` for the catalogs a replay folds under (R767000; `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`).
- A test that would have caught the class: Solarius Prime's own R656 test (`c038_1_solarius_prime.rs:246`) hard-codes seven helpful Spells from older sets, so it never checks a newer one. A catalog-wide test that casts every Spell whose declaration says `help` at a board with one Unit a side would hold the declared ones; it cannot find the undeclared ones, which is what the sweep is for.
- No ruling names either card's aim. R3869003 treats a declared aim as the truth of whether a card helps. `crates/ai/src` does not read `aim`, so the AI's own plays are unaffected.
- Documentation drift seen on the way: `spec/08-catalog.md` §8.11 row 12's Engine cell still says "+3 Health (Radiant +6)" while the text columns and the catalog say +5 and +10 since #3951.

Training Grounds #12 Fortify ("Give a Unit +5 Health, +1 Armor and Taunt"; Radiant adds Divine Shield) and #27 Hopeful Jelly Bean ("Make a permanent Radiant") declare their target with a bare `TargetDecl::target(1, 1, … "side": "any" …)` and no `aim`:

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/training_grounds/c027_hopeful_jelly_bean.rs:17`
